import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 998244353L;
    static final long MODD = 1000000007L;
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 1000005;
    static final long INF = 1000000000000000000L;

    static long[] power_of_ten = new long[15];
    static List<String>[] digit_groups = new List[7];
    static List<Long>[][] processed_values = new List[7][7];
    static long[][] cumulative_sums = new long[7][7];

    static long convert_to_number(String str) {
        long result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < str.length(); i++) {
            char ch = str.charAt(i);
            result = result * 10 + (ch - '0');
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long process_string(String prefix, int remaining_length, long[] counter) {
        if (remaining_length == -1) return 0;

        int left_part_length = remaining_length / 2;
        int right_part_length = remaining_length - left_part_length;
        if (remaining_length == 1) {
            left_part_length = 1;
            right_part_length = 0;
        }

        long total = (int)((counter[0] - convert_to_number(prefix) + MOD * MOD) % MOD);
        counter[0]++;

        for (String left_segment : digit_groups[left_part_length]) {
            String combined = prefix + left_segment;
            total = (int)((total + (-convert_to_number(combined) + counter[0] + MOD * MOD) % MOD) % MOD);
            counter[0]++;

            if (left_segment.length() == left_part_length) {
                long value = convert_to_number(combined) % MOD;
                for (int right_size = 1; right_size <= right_part_length; ++right_size) {
                    long constant = (int)((-value * power_of_ten[right_size] + counter[0] + MOD * MOD) % MOD);
                    List<Long> vec = processed_values[right_part_length][right_size];
                    int pos = Collections.binarySearch(vec, MOD - constant);
                    if (pos < 0) pos = -pos - 1;
                    long size = vec.size();
                    total = (int)((total + size * constant + cumulative_sums[right_part_length][right_size] - MOD * (size - pos)) % MOD);
                }
                counter[0] += digit_groups[right_part_length].size();
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        String num_str = String.valueOf(n);
        int total_digits = num_str.length();

        power_of_ten[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 14; ++i) {
            power_of_ten[i] = power_of_ten[i-1] * 10;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
            digit_groups[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j <= 6; ++j) {
                processed_values[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; ++i) {
            String current = String.valueOf(i);
            String padded = current;
            while (padded.length() <= 6) {
                padded = "0" + padded;
                digit_groups[padded.length()].add(padded);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 1; len <= 6; ++len) {
            for (String prev : digit_groups[len-1]) {
                digit_groups[len].add(prev);
            }
            Collections.sort(digit_groups[len]);

            for (int idx = 0; idx < digit_groups[len].size(); ++idx) {
                String s = digit_groups[len].get(idx);
                long val = (idx - Integer.parseInt(s) + MOD) % MOD;
                processed_values[len][s.length()].add(val);
            }

            for (int sz = 1; sz <= len; ++sz) {
                Collections.sort(processed_values[len][sz]);
                for (long v : processed_values[len][sz]) {
                    cumulative_sums[len][sz] = (cumulative_sums[len][sz] + v) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        List<Pair> query_list = new ArrayList<>();
        StringBuilder current_string = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0; i < num_str.length(); ++i) {
            for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
                if (digit == num_str.charAt(i) - '0') continue;
                if (i == 0 && digit == 0) continue;

                current_string.append((char)('0' + digit));
                if (digit <= num_str.charAt(i) - '0') {
                    query_list.add(new Pair(current_string.toString(), num_str.length() - i - 1));
                } else {
                    query_list.add(new Pair(current_string.toString(), num_str.length() - i - 2));
                }
                current_string.setLength(current_string.length() - 1);
            }
            current_string.append(num_str.charAt(i));
            query_list.add(new Pair(current_string.toString(), 0));
        }

        long[] counter = {1};
        long final_answer = 0;
        Collections.sort(query_list, (a, b) -> a.s.compareTo(b.s));

        for (Pair item : query_list) {
            if (num_str.length() > item.s.length() - 1 && num_str.charAt(item.s.length() - 1) == item.s.charAt(item.s.length() - 1)) {
                final_answer = (final_answer + (-convert_to_number(item.s) + counter[0] + MOD * MOD) % MOD) % MOD;
                counter[0]++;
                continue;
            }
            final_answer = (final_answer + process_string(item.s, item.len, counter)) % MOD;
        }

        final_answer = (final_answer % MODD + MODD) % MODD;
        pw.println(final_answer);
        pw.close();
    }

    static class Pair {
        String s;
        int len;

        Pair(String s, int len) {
            this.s = s;
            this.len = len;
        }
    }
}
